claim_scope: BOTH. CH: the near-side output is the same TX cell and pad before the declared channel (spec/channel/channel_rc.cir adds nothing here). TC: spec/test-configuration.md:72 reads the on-die array skew through the shmoo; this record is the single-lane-pair statistical spread of that skew, pre-layout, not the array measurement and not a wire-bond loopback result
bench: tb_t14.cir: data lane A (aib_tx_data) rises, the center-aligned aib_tx_clk pair (padc - padcb) rises 500 ps later; the graded quantity is data-to-clock delay at the TX pad nodes minus the nominal 0.5 UI
skew_definition: signed difference, limits +-bound, target_sigma 7 each side (DR-0019)

sample_size.basis: 20-draw pilot; the pilot run is the recorded run

result.tail: worst draw 14.4 ps against the +-20 ps (0.02 UI at 1 Gb/s) limit

note: T-14 FAILS the 7-sigma gate (lower confidence bound 5.48 against 7): pooled over the 45-corner grid mean 1.0 ps, sigma 3.3 ps, sigma-to-spec 5.75 against 7. No draw falls outside the limit (worst 14.4 ps against 20); the row fails on the tail the spec asks for (14 sigma peak-to-peak), not on a sampled violation. The distribution is not normal (Anderson-Darling rejected), so the normal-model sigma-to-spec is indicative. Pooled grid, as for T-10. Recorded, not tuned; the limit and the sigma convention are not relaxed. Negative control: an extra 2 pF on the data lane's pad (tb_t14_ctl.cir, not design evidence), detected (0 of 900 pass).
